preprocess.preflight.convert_toan_bo_text_thanh_duong_path: Convert all text to vector paths (Create Outlines). Definitively solves missing-font issues and is 100% safe, but the text can no longer be edited.
preprocess.preflight.danh_dau_cac_trang_chua_doi_tuong_su: Flags pages containing objects that use transparency effects (Transparency, Drop Shadow). Some older RIP systems mishandle these, causing lost detail or white edges.
preprocess.preflight.khong_phat_hien_loi_nao_trong_cac_muc: ✅ No errors detected in the selected checks!
preprocess.preflight.kiem_tra_kich_thuoc_cac_trang_khong: Checks for pages of inconsistent size. Off-size pages can cause imposition or registration errors on the press.
preprocess.preflight.kiem_tra_phien_ban_pdf_co_tuong_thich: Checks whether the PDF version is compatible with print standards. Too old (<1.3) lacks ICC/Transparency support; too new (>1.7) may be incompatible with the RIP.
preprocess.preflight.kiem_tra_xem_file_pdf_co_duoc_thiet_lap: Checks whether the PDF has valid TrimBox and BleedBox set. Missing bleed leads to white paper edges showing after trimming the finished product.
preprocess.preflight.kiem_tra_xem_tat_ca_font_chu_da_duoc: Checks whether all fonts are fully embedded in the PDF. Non-embedded fonts may be substituted by the RIP’s default font, causing text-shifting and accent errors.
preprocess.preflight.lam_phang_flatten_toan_bo_hieu_ung: Flattens all transparency and drop-shadow effects into static vector/bitmap. Ensures the file is fully safe for CTP plate output on any system.
preprocess.preflight.phan_tich_va_liet_ke_cac_kenh_mau_pha: Analyzes and lists existing spot color channels (Spot Color / Pantone). Helps avoid outputting extra plates or mis-costing the print job.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_anh_co_dpi_vuot_qua_600_gay: Detects images over 600 DPI. Causes unnecessary file size and slow RIP processing. Reduce to 300 DPI with Downscale.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_anh_dang_indexed_gif_palette: Detects Indexed (GIF/palette) images limited to 256 colors. Very poor print quality, banding, lost gradient detail. Replace with TIFF or high-quality JPEG.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_anh_jpeg_su_dung_progressive: Detects JPEG images using Progressive encoding. Some older RIP systems (especially PostScript Level 2) cannot process these, causing print errors or blank images.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_cac_doi_tuong_cai_dat: Detects objects with incorrect Overprint settings (e.g. white text set to overprint becomes invisible when printed). Warns about knockout mechanism errors.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_cac_hinh_anh_bitmap_co_do: Detects low-resolution bitmap images (under 200 DPI). Low-res images become pixelated and jagged, failing to reach sharp quality in actual printing.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_doi_tuong_text_anh_vector_net: Detects objects (text, image, vector, stroke) lying entirely outside the print area (TrimBox/MediaBox). May cause RIP errors or unnecessary processing time. Best removed.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_file_pdf_duoc_xuat_tu: Detects a PDF (exported from Illustrator/Corel) containing virtual paths instead of embedded images. Opening it in design software will drop the images.
preprocess.preflight.phat_hien_vung_co_tong_muc_c_m_y_k_spot: Detects areas where Total Area Coverage (C+M+Y+K + spot) exceeds the configured threshold (default 300%). Causes slow drying and set-off when printing.
preprocess.preflight.quet_toan_bo_tai_lieu_de_tim_cac_doi: Scans the whole document for image, vector or text objects using RGB/Lab color. These color spaces can cause severe color shifts in offset (CMYK) printing.
preprocess.preflight.toi_uu_hoa_dung_luong_bang_cach_giam_do: Optimizes file size by downsampling over-detailed images (>600 DPI) to the 300 DPI print standard. Makes the file lighter and the RIP faster.
preprocess.preflight.tu_dong_chuyen_doi_toan_bo_doi_tuong: Automatically converts all RGB/Lab objects to standard print CMYK. Uses the FOGRA39 (Coated) ICC profile for the highest color accuracy.
preprocess.preflight.xoa_bo_cac_du_lieu_an_metadata_thua: Removes hidden data, excess metadata, comments, forms, or unnecessary XML tags in the PDF structure. Cleans the file and prevents compatibility errors.

preprocess.savePdfx.khi_xuat_pdf_x_1a_he_thong_tu_chuyen: When exporting PDF/X-1a, the system converts all RGB to CMYK using the configured color profile (ICC).
preprocess.savePdfx.khi_xuat_pdf_x_1a_he_thong_tu_lam_phang: When exporting PDF/X-1a, the system flattens all transparency areas into solid image/vector.
preprocess.savePdfx.khi_xuat_pdf_x_ghostscript_tu_ha_nang: When exporting PDF/X, Ghostscript automatically lowers/raises the PDF version to match the standard — so this item is always handled automatically.

preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_file_chi_dung_he_mau_cmyk: Checks that the file uses only the CMYK color space, with no remaining RGB colors.
preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_file_da_gan_output_intent_ho: Checks that the file has an Output Intent attached — an ICC color profile describing the target print condition.
preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_file_khong_con_hieu_ung_trong: Checks that the file has no unflattened transparency effects remaining.
preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_moi_phong_chu_trong_file_da: Checks whether every font in the file has been embedded into the PDF.
preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_moi_trang_da_khai_bao_trimbox: Checks whether each page declares a TrimBox (the finished-size frame — the final cut line).
preprocess.savePdfx.kiem_tra_phien_ban_pdf_phu_hop_voi: Checks that the PDF version matches the chosen standard (X-1a needs 1.3, X-4 needs 1.6).
preprocess.savePdfx.may_in_offset_in_bang_4_muc_cmyk_mau: Offset presses print with 4 CMYK inks. RGB colors (from photos, screens) shift unpredictably when printed because they must be converted at the RIP. PDF/X-1a requires CMYK so printed colors match the proof.
preprocess.savePdfx.moi_chuan_pdf_x_gan_voi_mot_phien_ban: Each PDF/X standard is tied to a specific PDF version to ensure only RIP-supported features are used. A wrong version may contain features the standard disallows.
preprocess.savePdfx.neu_phong_khong_nhung_may_rip_cua_nha: If fonts are not embedded, a print shop RIP that lacks the font will substitute another — causing font shifts, wrong spacing, even missing text. The PDF/X standard requires embedding all fonts.
preprocess.savePdfx.output_intent_cho_nha_in_biet_file_duoc: The Output Intent tells the printer which standard the file was color-managed to (e.g. Coated FOGRA39). It is the file's "color ID card", required in every PDF/X standard for accurate color reproduction.
preprocess.savePdfx.transparency_do_bong_mo_chong_lop_co: Transparency (drop shadows, layer blending) can display differently on older RIPs, causing deviation from the proof. PDF/X-1a requires flattening for stable print results.
preprocess.savePdfx.trimbox_cho_nha_in_biet_chinh_xac_mep: The TrimBox tells the printer exactly where the finished cut edge is, distinguishing it from the bleed (overhang) that gets trimmed off. Without a TrimBox, the imposition/cutting machine does not know where to cut.
preprocess.savePdfx.tuong_thich_cao_cmyk_only_flatten: Highly compatible, CMYK only, flattened transparency. Suits most print shops.
